Definition: neuter of the comparative of G1618; more intently:--more earnestly.
BiblicalUsage: ektenésteron is the word for more earnestly. In Luke 22:44, the text says "And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, ektenésteron, I take at face value: more earnestly.
RelatedEvents: The Last Supper; Jesus Prays in Gethsemane
